P3A-B-EVAL-ST-REVERSE_REPLACE-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
SENTENCE reversed=strings.REVERSE(text).
DISPLAYNL(strings.REPLACE(reversed,"a","!")).
P3A-B-EVAL-FI-CASE_JOIN-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.CONCAT(strings.CONCAT(strings.UPPER(left),":"),strings.LOWER(right)),"a")).
P3A-B-EVAL-FI-CONTAINS_BRANCH-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
IF (strings.CONTAINS(left,"a") AND strings.CONTAINS(right,"a")) { DISPLAYNL("YES"). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL("NO"). }
